ideas.pitch: An interactive execution visualizer designed specifically for the DSA WAR core concepts, showing memory states, pointer manipulations, and recursion trees step-by-step.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace: Real-time DSA Execution Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core focus of the hackathon on mastering data structures, helping competitors immediately debug their mental models of arrays, trees, and graphs during quizzes.

ideas.pitch: A platform that maps difficult coding round problems to abstract underlying patterns like sliding window, two pointers, and monotonic stacks to accelerate competitor learning.
ideas.title: PatternForge: Reusable DSA Pattern Recognition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the hackathon's stated goal of teaching patterns you can reuse in interviews and placements, providing immediate utility to participants.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight linter and analyzer that predicts the time and space complexity of user-submitted code snippets under strict time pressure constraints.
ideas.title: ComplexityMeter: Automated Static Code Complexity Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the complexity analysis component of Round 1, offering a genuinely hard technical utility that works reliably in a live demo.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config diagnostic tool that captures recursive function execution paths and generates real-time call trees to debug stack overflows instantly.
ideas.title: RecursionTree: Visual Call-Stack Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a notoriously difficult visualization problem for recursion and sorting algorithms, mirroring the pattern of winning projects that solve genuinely hard engineering tasks.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end simulation environment combining timed quizzes and progressive coding rounds that mimics real placement tests under a strict clock.
ideas.title: MockWar: Solo Timed Placement Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the hackathon's promise of practicing the way placements actually work, giving a solo developer a complete, highly polished product by the end of the weekend.
